patterns_found.visual_evidence: Both sketches show a header bar with a distinct boxed field/control on the right side, consistent with a search box in the reference layout.
patterns_found.behavior_notes: Should support text entry and search submission. On desktop it likely includes a visible submit affordance; on mobile the compact header suggests submit may occur via keyboard action or a smaller control.
patterns_found.ambiguities: The sketches do not show whether results are live/autocomplete or only submitted on enter/button press.

patterns_found.visual_evidence: The search field is an input-based control that implies submit behavior and basic handling of empty or malformed queries.
patterns_found.behavior_notes: Should validate/sanitize submitted input, handle empty submissions gracefully, and provide clear focus and error handling if submission is blocked.
patterns_found.ambiguities: No explicit error state is drawn, so validation may be minimal rather than visibly surfaced.

sketch_notes: The sketches imply a largely static informational page with very low JavaScript complexity. Across both viewports, the only clearly interactive element is the header search control; the rest reads as static text, tables, links, and separators rather than expandable, tabbed, modal, or scroll-reactive UI. Mobile and desktop differ mainly in density and header sizing, not in interaction model.
